arvidgrubb: By the time Quentin Arvidgrubb reached R-F20, the war was 3 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
During a lull at Hill 304, Quentin Arvidgrubb called across from the Concord line. Severin Heheheha answered from the Hegemony side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
max_latsch: Cyril "Tin" Latsch arrived on Day 4 as a replacement. The men in R-F3 had been fighting for 3 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Cyril "Tin" Latsch pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
